moments.title: The Last Game Before the Roof Fell
moments.dek: UConn upset UMass 56-49 on a snowy Tuesday night in Hartford; about six hours later, 1,400 tons of roof crashed onto the Civic Center's 10,000 empty seats.

moments.title: The Night Gampel Pavilion Opened
moments.dek: Before a sellout crowd of 8,241, UConn opened its new on-campus arena by beating No. 15 St. John's 72-58 and moving into a tie for first in the Big East.

moments.title: UConn's First Big East Tournament Crown
moments.dek: Down 10-0 to top-seeded Syracuse, UConn rallied behind its pressing defense and 58 points from three guards to win 78-75 — its first Big East tournament title.

moments.title: UConn Stuns Duke for First National Title
moments.dek: Nine-and-a-half-point underdogs, UConn snapped Duke's 32-game winning streak, 77-74, as Ricky Moore's defense forced Trajan Langdon into a travel with 5.4 seconds left.

moments.title: UConn's 12-0 Finish Stuns Duke
moments.dek: Down 75-67 with 3:28 left, UConn rallied with a 12-0 run behind Emeka Okafor, who sat most of the first half with two fouls, then scored 18.

moments.title: UConn Overwhelms Georgia Tech for Second Title
moments.dek: Emeka Okafor's 24 points and 15 rebounds powered UConn past Georgia Tech, 82-73, for its second national title in six seasons, a night before the UConn women won theirs.

moments.title: Six Overtimes at the Garden
moments.dek: A waved-off buzzer-beater, five overtimes in which UConn took the lead and Syracuse answered, and a 127-117 Orange win that ended at 1:22 a.m.

moments.title: Kemba's Step-Back Sinks Top-Seeded Pitt
moments.dek: On UConn's third day in a row at the Garden, Kemba Walker crossed over Pitt center Gary McGhee, who fell, and swished a step-back jumper at the buzzer.

moments.title: UConn Smothers Butler for Title No. 3
moments.dek: Butler shot 12 for 64, the worst in title-game history, as UConn ground out a 53-41 win and a third national championship to end an 11-game postseason run.

moments.title: Napier Beats Florida at the Horn
moments.dek: Trapped, limping and off balance, Shabazz Napier missed — then caught DeAndre Daniels' blind tip-back at the free-throw line and beat the horn: UConn 65, No. 15 Florida 64.

moments.title: The Hungry Huskies Win It All
moments.dek: A year after an academic ban kept them out of the NCAA tournament, seventh-seeded UConn never trailed Kentucky's freshmen and won its fourth national title, 60-54.

moments.title: Jalen Adams' Heave Forces a Fourth Overtime
moments.dek: Down three with 0.8 seconds left in the third overtime, freshman Jalen Adams banked in a three-quarter-court heave — and UConn outlasted Cincinnati 104-97 in four overtimes.

moments.title: Five for Five in Houston
moments.dek: In Houston, UConn smothered San Diego State 76-59 for its fifth national title: five wins in five title games, and six tournament wins, all by double digits.

hero.credit: Video still · March Madness, "One Shining Moment" 2023

moments.title: Thirty Straight: UConn Buries Illinois
moments.dek: Tied 23-23 late in the first half, UConn scored the next 30 points against Illinois in Boston and rolled 77-52 into a second straight Final Four.

moments.title: Back-to-Back: UConn Repeats in Glendale
moments.dek: UConn let Zach Edey score 37, took away Purdue's 3-pointers and won 75-60, becoming the first repeat national champion since Florida in 2006 and 2007.

hero.credit: Video still · March Madness, "One Shining Moment" 2024

moments.title: Mullins From the Logo Stuns Duke
moments.dek: Down 19 in the first half to top overall seed Duke, UConn won 73-72 on freshman Braylon Mullins's 35-foot 3-pointer with 0.4 seconds left.
